title: Present Perfect: Uso, Conjugação e Conexão com o Presente
rawContent: TODAY’S TAKEAWAYSGRAMMARVOCABULARYPRONUNCIATIONFURTHER PRACTICE WITH PRESENT PERFECT CONNECTED TO NOWExample: - Lisa’s phone battery was at 35%, but now it’s at 100%.- Lisa has charged her phone.Present perfect: subject + have / has + past participleRegular verbs have the same form in past simple and present perfect.1. Sarah's hair was long. Now it is very short.Sarah has cut her hair.2. The floor was dirty. Now it is clean.The floor has been cleaned. – O chão foi limpo (by my sister)My sister has cleaned the floor. – Minha irmã limpou o chão.3. Mark's car isn’t in his garage. He is walking to work.Mark has sold his car. 4. The oven is warm and there is a cake on the table.My mother has cooked /baked a cake.5. They are standing outside because they don't have their keys.They have lost their keys.6. The ground is wet and there are puddles everywhere.It has rained.7. I am not hungry anymore. My plate is empty.I have eaten all the food. I have had lunch. 8. The TV is off and the room is quiet.My dad has slept. My dad has gone to bed.My dad has gone to sleep. 9. James has a bandage on his finger and he's in pain.James has cut his finger.James has hurt his finger.10. The email is in the draft box. Present perfect: I haven’t finished it yet.Present simple: I don’t finish any email I start. Past simple: I didn’t finish the email yesterday.11. I don't see my phone anywhere on the desk.Present perfect: It has been taken to a service shop / a technician / a repair shop.                It has been lost. Present simple: I always lose my cell phone.Past simple: I lost my cell phone yesterday.12. Her computer is off and she isn’t at her office desk. Present perfect: She has gone home.Present continuous: She is driving now.Present simple: She is happy.Past simple: She went away after class.13. The window is broken and there is a ball on the floor.Present perfect: We haven’t cleared the floor yet. Present simple: We clear the floor from the toys every day.Present continuous: We are clearing the floor from the toys.Past simple: We cleared the floor from the toys one hour ago.Past continuous: We were clearing the floor from the toys when my mother arrived.14. People are leaving the cinema.Present Perfect: The movie has finished.Past Simple: The movie finished at 3.00 pm. Present Simple: The movie usually finishes at 3.00 pm.Present Continuous: The movie is finishing now.Past Continuous: The movie was finishing when I woke up. 15. I know this author. He’s very good. Present Perfect: I’ve read three of his books. Present Simple: I read three books every week. Present Continuous: I’m reading three books at the same time.Past Simple: I read three books last month.Past Continuous: I was reading three books when I had to do an eye surgery.We haven’t had dinner yet. We haven’t done homework yet.We don’t do homework on Sundays.

enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do Present Perfect em diferentes contextos, conectando ações passadas ao momento presente. Exemplos práticos e comparações com outros tempos verbais ajudam a entender a aplicação gramatical.
mainTopics: Conjugação de verbos regulares e irregulares
Conexão de ações passadas ao presente

vocabulary.definition: To fill a device with electricity.
To separate or divide something using a sharp tool.
To remove dirt or make something tidy.
examples: My sister has cleaned the floor.

vocabulary.definition: To exchange an item for money.
To prepare food by heating it.
examples: My mother has cooked a cake.

vocabulary.definition: To no longer have something because it is missing.
To fall as rain from the sky.

examples: I have eaten all the food.
My dad has gone to sleep.
It has been taken to a service shop.

vocabulary.definition: To look at and understand written words.
examples: I’ve read three of his books.

grammar.explanation: The Present Perfect connects past actions or events to the present moment.
rules: Used to describe actions that have an effect on the present.
commonMistakes: Confusing Present Perfect with Past Simple.
Using Present Perfect without proper connection to the present.

expressions.usage: Used to indicate someone has retired for sleep.
examples: My dad has gone to bed.

expressions.usage: Used to show the floor is clean now.

practiceQuestions.question: Complete: Lisa’s phone battery was at 35%, but now it’s at 100%. Lisa _____ her phone.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The Present Perfect is used to indicate an action completed with a current result.

practiceQuestions.question: Translate: Eu não vejo meu telefone em nenhum lugar na mesa.
practiceQuestions.answer: I don’t see my phone anywhere on the desk.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The sentence is in Present Simple for a current observation.

culturalNotes: O Present Perfect é usado frequentemente em inglês britânico, enquanto o Past Simple é mais comum em inglês americano em contextos similares.
A conexão com o presente é essencial para o uso correto do Present Perfect.
studyTips: Pratique a diferenciação entre Present Perfect e Past Simple com exemplos concretos.
Use frases do dia a dia para entender melhor o impacto do Present Perfect no presente.
originalExamples: Lisa’s phone battery was at 35%, but now it’s at 100%. (A bateria do telefone de Lisa estava em 35%, mas agora está em 100%.)
Lisa has charged her phone. (Lisa carregou seu telefone.)
Sarah's hair was long. Now it is very short. (O cabelo de Sarah era longo. Agora está muito curto.)
The floor was dirty. Now it is clean. (O chão estava sujo. Agora está limpo.)
My sister has cleaned the floor. (Minha irmã limpou o chão.)
Mark's car isn’t in his garage. He is walking to work. (O carro de Mark não está na garagem. Ele está indo trabalhar a pé.)
Mark has sold his car. (Mark vendeu seu carro.)
The oven is warm and there is a cake on the table. (O forno está quente e há um bolo na mesa.)
My mother has cooked a cake. (Minha mãe assou um bolo.)
They are standing outside because they don't have their keys. (Eles estão do lado de fora porque não têm suas chaves.)
They have lost their keys. (Eles perderam suas chaves.)
The ground is wet and there are puddles everywhere. (O chão está molhado e há poças por toda parte.)
It has rained. (Choveu.)
I am not hungry anymore. My plate is empty. (Não estou mais com fome. Meu prato está vazio.)
I have eaten all the food. (Eu comi toda a comida.)
I have had lunch. (Eu almocei.)
The TV is off and the room is quiet. (A TV está desligada e o quarto está quieto.)
My dad has slept. (Meu pai dormiu.)
My dad has gone to bed. (Meu pai foi para a cama.)
My dad has gone to sleep. (Meu pai foi dormir.)
James has a bandage on his finger and he's in pain. (James tem um curativo no dedo e está com dor.)
James has cut his finger. (James cortou o dedo.)
James has hurt his finger. (James machucou o dedo.)
The email is in the draft box. (O email está na caixa de rascunhos.)
I haven’t finished it yet. (Eu ainda não terminei.)
I don’t finish any email I start. (Eu não termino nenhum email que eu começo.)
I didn’t finish the email yesterday. (Eu não terminei o email ontem.)
I don’t see my phone anywhere on the desk. (Eu não vejo meu telefone em nenhum lugar na mesa.)
It has been taken to a service shop. (Ele foi levado a uma oficina.)
It has been lost. (Ele foi perdido.)
Her computer is off and she isn’t at her office desk. (O computador dela está desligado e ela não está na mesa do escritório.)
She has gone home. (Ela foi para casa.)
She is driving now. (Ela está dirigindo agora.)
She is happy. (Ela está feliz.)
She went away after class. (Ela saiu depois da aula.)
The window is broken and there is a ball on the floor. (A janela está quebrada e há uma bola no chão.)
We haven’t cleared the floor yet. (Nós ainda não limpamos o chão.)
We clear the floor from the toys every day. (Nós limpamos o chão dos brinquedos todos os dias.)
We are clearing the floor from the toys. (Nós estamos limpando o chão dos brinquedos.)
We cleared the floor from the toys one hour ago. (Nós limpamos o chão dos brinquedos há uma hora.)
We were clearing the floor from the toys when my mother arrived. (Nós estávamos limpando o chão dos brinquedos quando minha mãe chegou.)
People are leaving the cinema. (As pessoas estão saindo do cinema.)
The movie has finished. (O filme acabou.)
The movie finished at 3.00 pm. (O filme acabou às 15h.)
The movie usually finishes at 3.00 pm. (O filme geralmente termina às 15h.)
The movie is finishing now. (O filme está terminando agora.)
The movie was finishing when I woke up. (O filme estava terminando quando eu acordei.)
I know this author. He’s very good. (Eu conheço este autor. Ele é muito bom.)
I’ve read three of his books. (Eu li três livros dele.)
I read three books every week. (Eu leio três livros toda semana.)
I’m reading three books at the same time. (Eu estou lendo três livros ao mesmo tempo.)
I read three books last month. (Eu li três livros no mês passado.)
I was reading three books when I had to do an eye surgery. (Eu estava lendo três livros quando precisei fazer uma cirurgia no olho.)
We haven’t had dinner yet. (Nós ainda não jantamos.)
We haven’t done homework yet. (Nós ainda não fizemos a lição de casa.)
We don’t do homework on Sundays. (Nós não fazemos lição de casa aos domingos.)

warnings: practiceQuestions tem apenas 2 item(ns), recomendado mínimo de 3
